s: E-6 WALKED o8 EPILOGUE: one fmt=1 descriptor; the sequencer fetches DDR weights, drives the GEMMs WITH requant, frames the o8 stream, and the tile consumes it (deq -> residual -> r1).
phase A: CSR sanity + illegal-descriptor reject + tier init
INFO_TIER expect retargeted 0x7->0x1 (image b64_05b: KVQ_OUTLIER_K=0, KVQ_GQA_NENG=2 -> CQ-8-only; apex_top.sv:2540-2543). Jobs are CQ-8; NO datapath expectation touched.
loader token: h8=[127,1,0...] via real RMSNorm+feeder
[host, pre-walk] stage the 14 C-1 activation frames into act bank 1 (amax-127 identity staging)

[host, pre-walk] preload the residual row RAM with the f16 LAYER INPUT row X[T] — the row RES1 adds onto (its legitimate role; LAYER_PTR bank 2, auto-inc). ser_dst / resid_arm / the route are NOT touched: the WALKER arms all of them (PC_LVLO + RT_FPRQ).
IB-FUEL arm: mode only (src=1, ar_owner=1). The walker issues the records itself.
load the fmt=1 descriptor (64 words incl. the RQ[H]/JC_OPROJ calibration slots) and KICK.
RO drain, 144 raw QKV jobs (data plane, E-5's disclosed class — the 16-deep RO FIFO must be paced). The OPROJ epilogue that follows produces NO RO traffic.
the walk retired, and it retired CLEAN
[host, post-walk] LAYER hygiene: no unit refused, all quiet (the walker's own S2_PJW already waited on LST_LDQ|LST_RES)
[host, post-walk] read r1 back: 896 produce-mode caps (LAYER_RDATA auto-inc). The walk's OUTPUT — never foreknown.
final: quiescence + sticky accounting + PERF + F-3 clear
